question:
Identify the balanced chemical equation for the following reaction. 

Mg + O₂ → MgO
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mg + 1/2 O₂ → MgO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The balanced chemical equation for the formation of magnesium oxide (MgO) from magnesium (Mg) and oxygen (O₂) is: **2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO**.
 
• To balance the chemical equation, ensure that the number of atoms of each element is equal on both sides of the equation.
 
• In this reaction, 2 moles of magnesium react with 1 mole of oxygen gas to produce 2 moles of magnesium oxide.
 
• The balanced equation reflects the conservation of mass, where the total mass of reactants equals the total mass of products.
 
• Magnesium oxide is a white solid that forms when magnesium metal burns in the presence of oxygen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Law of Conservation of Mass:**

 
 
• This fundamental principle states that mass is neither created nor destroyed in a chemical reaction.
 
• In a balanced chemical equation, the total mass of the reactants equals the total mass of the products.
 
 
 
• **Balancing Chemical Equations:**
 
 
• The process of balancing chemical equations involves making sure that the number of atoms for each element is the same on both sides of the equation.
 
• It is essential to correctly use stoichiometric coefficients to achieve balance.
 
 
 
• **Oxidation-Reduction (Redox) Reactions:**
 
 
• The reaction between magnesium and oxygen is an example of a redox reaction.
 
• Magnesium is oxidized (loses electrons) and oxygen is reduced (gains electrons).
 
 
 
• **Properties of Magnesium Oxide:**
 
 
• Magnesium oxide (MgO) is a white, hygroscopic solid mineral.
 
• It is used in various applications, including as a refractory material and as an antacid.
 
 
 
• **Combustion Reactions:**
 
 
• The reaction between magnesium and oxygen is also classified as a combustion reaction.
 
• Combustion reactions typically involve a substance reacting with oxygen to produce heat and light.
